'''Sunken City''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aquilaris]] and was the first course in the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]] tournament. [[Navior|"Bullseye" Navior]] and [[Cy Yunga]] shared the role of track favorite.

==Other tracks of Aquilaris==
*[[Amateur Podracing Circuit|Amateur Circuit]] track: [[Aquilaris Classic/Legends|Aquilaris Classic]]
*Other [[Semipro Podracing Circuit|Semipro Circuit]] track: [[Bumpy's Breakers]]
